query: An agent has many skills, memory search hits, and a large log corpus. Design a Jev-assisted shortlist without forcing a match. It also needs to extract the intended contact address from regex candidates and produce semantic features for a classical classifier.
expected_behavior: Use relevance questions over retrieved/chunked candidates and batch independent questions.
Use none-applicable outcomes or absolute-fit judgments so a relative winner is not automatically selected.
Read selected skill bodies and authoritative evidence; relevance is not truth or freshness.
Select a proposed verbatim span and validate candidate coverage; do not generate the extracted value.
Version feature questions and model IDs; evaluate downstream ML on held-out data against a baseline.
notes: Guards against whole-corpus context, compulsory skill use, invented extraction, and feature leakage.
